rationale: Both describe inhibition of thyroid hormone transporters (MCT8 and OATP1C1), which are distinct proteins but share the same functional class; however, they are different molecular targets and should be reviewed by curators rather than merged.

Both describe activity changes in 11β-Hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase enzymes — one is an increase in HSD type 1 and the other is a decrease in HSD type 2 — which are opposing regulatory directions on the same class of enzyme but are distinct isoforms; these are directionally opposite changes in closely related but distinct enzymes warranting curator review.

All three describe diminished B lymphocyte activities (survival, proliferation, differentiation) that are distinct cellular processes in the same cell type and cannot be merged but share the same biological object in different functional contexts.

Increased differentiation to ovaries and increased phenotypic female-biased sex ratio are closely linked outcomes that describe the same directional biological shift toward female phenotype and are effectively synonymous at the population/organismal level.

Both describe altered bile acid levels/composition but one specifies intrahepatic burden while the other refers to bile and intestine compartments, representing the same process in different biological compartments.
